description: Source code for the Windows DHCP PAC file adapter fetcher in Chromium, handling DHCP queries to retrieve PAC URLs and managing fetch operations with timeout and cancellation.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Handles DHCP-based PAC URL fetching on Windows, including timeout and cancellation logic.

classes.name: DhcpQuery
classes.description: Represents a DHCP query to retrieve PAC URL for a network adapter.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Initiates DHCP query and fetches PAC script from the obtained URL.

methods.name: DidFinish
methods.description: Checks if fetch operation has completed.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Returns the result code of the fetch operation.

methods.name: GetPacURL
methods.description: Returns the PAC URL obtained via DHCP.

methods.name: DhcpQuery::GetPacURLForAdapter
methods.description: Performs DHCP request to get PAC URL for a specific network adapter.

methods.name: OnDhcpQueryDone
methods.description: Handles completion of DHCP query, initiates script fetch if URL is valid.

methods.name: OnFetcherDone
methods.description: Handles completion of PAC script fetch.

methods.name: TransitionToFinish
methods.description: Transitions fetch state to finished and runs callback.

methods.name: ImplCreateScriptFetcher
methods.description: Creates a PAC file fetcher instance.

methods.name: ImplGetTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for DHCP query.

methods.name: GetPacURLFromDhcp
methods.description: Static method to perform DHCP request to retrieve PAC URL.

methods.name: SanitizeDhcpApiString
methods.description: Sanitizes DHCP API string data to ASCII and trims whitespace.
